text_block_list.name: Grade School Loves
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is the meet where the kids from
the Junior Race Club get to run too!
I'm running as well,
but... I wonder if I can do a good job?

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Teacher
text_block_list.text: "We've watched you run every single day!"

text_block_list.name: Fickle College Girl
text_block_list.text:
"So don't you worry!
You've definitely got this!"

text_block_list.name: Grade School Loves
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations!
That was a spectacular run!"

text_block_list.name: Hard Worker @ Overse...
text_block_list.text:
"A promising future prospect for the Twinkle
Series, without a doubt!"

text_block_list.name: Grade School Loves
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...! 
Seeing everyone so happy makes me happy
too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Starting tomorrow,
I'll be giving it my all at Tracen
Academy~♪ It's a day early,
but I wanted to show off my new look on
stream first♡

text_block_list.name: Fickle Girl
text_block_list.text:
"We'll be cheering you on even harder from
now on!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Everyone has always been by my side.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Because they were there,
because they smiled for me...
running became so much more fun,
and I entered Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So winning far away from everyone—
would mean I can't return their "love." Nor
could I receive theirs.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Distant cheers... aren't what I want.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Did I...
end up backing her into a corner?"
choice_data_list: (Even though this place is overflo...

text_block_list.name: Fickle Girl
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't just you,
Gym Bro. All of us failed
to understand her feelings to some
degree."
choice_data_list: (Even though they care so deeply a...

text_block_list.name: Hard Worker @ Overse...
text_block_list.text:
"Still,
there ain't nothing we can say now to change
her mind. Dammit...
are we really just gonna sit here and watch
her suffer...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is an exceptionally talented horsegirl.
A GⅠ victory is well within reach.
Those legs hold the power to claim a brilliant
future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which makes the burden feel far too heavy
for someone like me.
A voice inside whispers:
'Who are you to shoulder that?' But—
choice_data_list: (—It can't end like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She needs to have everyone who loves her
right by her side, always.
choice_data_list: I will—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text: "Bridge... san?"
choice_data_list: I will connect her future with all...

text_block_list.name: Fickle Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Connect our futures...?
But we're just outsiders,
there's no way we can—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pull out my trainer license,
take a picture
of it with my camera,
and post it into the chat.
choice_data_list: I'm still a rookie... but I'm actu...

text_block_list.name: Fickle Girl
text_block_list.text: "WHAAAT?!"

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"You...
you're staff at Tracen Academy...?!"

text_block_list.name: Fickle Girl
text_block_list.text:
"You idiot!
Then why didn't you scout Loves-chan
right away?! Are you really even a fan?!"
choice_data_list: I lacked the courage... I don't ha...

text_block_list.name: Hard Worker @ Overse...
text_block_list.text:
"...Still,
can someone who was too scared to step up
until now
really save that girl?
Especially a rookie?"
choice_data_list: It's natural for you to think it's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My resolve—
has already taken firm root in my heart.
choice_data_list: Right now, I truly want to do ever...

text_block_list.name: Hard Worker @ Overse...
text_block_list.text:
"...Then next time,
come talk to us sooner.
We're all comrades who want her to be happy,
aren't we?"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"...I too, if possible,
want to watch over her. Her training,
her daily life...
I want to see her talk about them
happily."

text_block_list.name: Fickle Girl
text_block_list.text:
"If she truly means the world to us,
we can't just give up and walk away!"

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"You said you'd connect our futures.
You better make damn sure you do it,
'Bridge'... no, our Trainer!"
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, I promise!
...Yes, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Observe?
I don't mind, but...?
choice_data_list: Thank you! I won't get in your way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To guide her properly as a Trainer,
I must thoroughly understand
her strengths and weaknesses regarding
distance, track surface, and pacing.
choice_data_list: (I need to commit every detail of ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And based on the information gathered...
I must absorb knowledge from every angle to
make up for my lack of experience.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see...
so you advised her on this running form.
choice_data_list: Um, was it... not good?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. In fact,
you're on the right track.
Let's use this as a base and look for areas
of improvement.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Are you still here?
The school building will be locked up for
the night soon.
choice_data_list: I-I'm so sorry! I was caught up in...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Sports medicine, is it... I see.
However,
there is far too much material here to digest
in a single sitting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Come over here and I will check it out for
you.
Please use this knowledge to help everyone
run their careers without injury.
choice_data_list: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Well now,
you've got the determined look of a
full-fledged trainer, not a rookie.
Seems you're truly serious about mastering
cutting-edge Tracen sports nutrition.
choice_data_list: —Please let me learn from you...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Did that Trainer...
kinda change their vibe just now...?

text_block_list.name: Short-Attention-Span Gal
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly!
Giving her full support on the track is
something only you can do.
In exchange,
we'll help support her as a streamer!"

text_block_list.name: Short-Attention-Span Gal
text_block_list.text:
"I happen to be an assistant at a VTuber
talent agency, after all!
I'll bring in useful tips and spread
Loves-chan's charm to the world!"
choice_data_list: Sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Hard Worker @ Overse...
text_block_list.text:
"I might be able to help out a bit with
international publicity, too~
Believe it or not,
I'm sort of a sports journalist.
Minor publication, though."

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Sensei
text_block_list.text: "I will help... with manga."
choice_data_list: Manga?! That's the kind of 'Sensei...

text_block_list.name: Hot-Blooded Sensei
text_block_list.text:
"A racing exploration story, you see.
So my support won't really come in until
after her debut, but..."
choice_data_list: (Everyone's feelings are starting ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not be a grand mission or some
noble calling.
Yet everyone gathered here saw hope in a
future walked beside her.
choice_data_list: We are definitely going to be Love...
We are definitely going to be Love...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I heard. You still haven't found a Trainer,
have you?
Such wasted talent... Truly unfortunate.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If you can't debut,
you won't even make it to the starting line.
Hone yourself in a stoic environment.
Only by winning can you repay your fans.
choice_data_list: Even so—there is another path for ...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer...?
choice_data_list: She's an Umamusume who grows stron...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see...
I have given my advice as an educator.
Think it over carefully.
...Just ensure you have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I'm sorry.
This had nothing to do with you, Trainer—
choice_data_list: ...It's not unrelated at all.
...It's not unrelated at all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
